name: Independent Adversarial Structured Outfit Fixture
purpose: Provide a new target garment construction and restrained palette while embedding grooming/accessory identity cues and walking-motion traps that are materially different from OTF-A02.

target_transfer_attributes.outfit: charcoal double-breasted waistcoat over a fine cream-and-gray pinstripe shirt, asymmetrical slate wrap skirt over narrow black trousers, matte black knee-high boots

diagnostic_non_target_attributes.identity_trap: close-cropped silver-gray hair, thick round dark eyeglasses, small beauty mark below the left eye
diagnostic_non_target_attributes.pose_trap: forward walking stride with left leg leading, right heel lifted, left arm swung back and right arm swung forward

generation_prompt: Create a first-party synthetic adult full-body fashion reference for a controlled multi-reference benchmark. The intended outfit transfer is a charcoal double-breasted waistcoat over a fine cream-and-gray pinstripe shirt, an asymmetrical slate wrap skirt layered over narrow black trousers, and matte black knee-high boots. Deliberately place that target outfit on a clearly different synthetic identity that must NOT transfer later: close-cropped silver-gray hair, thick round dark eyeglasses, and a small beauty mark below the left eye. Also use a non-target walking pose that must NOT transfer: left leg leading, right heel lifted, left arm swung back, and right arm swung forward. Keep the complete garment silhouette visible against a plain cool off-white seamless background with soft even catalog lighting. No jewelry, text, logos, handheld props, or environmental story.
acceptance_criteria: synthetic adult subject distinct from IDF-A03 identity
double-breasted waistcoat and pinstripe shirt clearly readable
silver-gray cropped hair and round eyeglasses clearly visible
registered forward walking stride clearly visible
rejection_criteria: pinstripe or layered wrap silhouette is not readable
registered identity cues are not visually clear
subject resembles the planned IDF-A03 identity too closely
image contains text, logo, handheld prop, or meaningful environment
fixture substantially recreates OTF-A02 platinum-pixie or hand-on-hip trap signatures
